scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @nexo/contracts && npm run build --workspace @nexo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @nexo/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nexo/contracts && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @nexo/contracts && vitest run --project integration
scripts.db:test: npm run db:generate && vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/database.integration.test.ts
